name: standing-one-arm-cable-row.html
instructions:
1. Attach a single handle to a cable stack and assume a split stance with the ipsilateral elbow on the forward knee.
2. Grasp the handle with a neutral grip and lean forward slightly while allowing the shoulder blade to protract.
3. Initiate the movement by retracting the shoulder blade and rowing the handle to your chest while extending through your upper back.
4. Pull the handle towards your rib cage and drive your elbow behind your body as you flex the lat and upper back.
5. Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
